comments.value: Might want to split these up into seperate posts; this site is structured like an issue tracker and the vrc team can't mark your post as "tracked internally", "planned", "complete", etc if you have a buncha different propositions in a single post.

details:
Propositions:
1. Special Friend Permissions: Special joining/inviting permissions can be set for individual friends similarly to how status can be set. These will bypass standard status settings like "Do not Disturb" depending on the setting.
2. Know you're Blocked: When attempting to add someone as a friend only to find that it isn't working, receive a pop-up saying that you're blocked... Or a notification if they just deny it. (Optional, some people may not want to see this).
3. Recently Played With: Another row to the social tab that shows who you played with most recently in your entire gameplay, just in case you meet a cool person and they leave before you can add them.
4. Messaging: Sending invites or invite requests with custom words can be a little tedious due to the severe limit in what can be said. Not to mention the likelihood that person may receive it.
Reasons:
1-1. Some people have friends that they'd like to let join at any time, or at least frequently. Allowing them to join depending on the certain status would be helpful.
2-1. Sometimes you meet a nice person but they don't like you and you start to feel that maybe there's a hint you should be getting.
2-2. Accidental harassment would likely be reduced.
3-1. (Reason already in proposition).
4-1. (Reason already in proposition).
4-2. Messages would free up the need for discord and quite possibly wait times for a friend to leave "Do not Disturb" mode.
title: New Social Features [Friend Joining/Inviting, Blocks, etc...]
